"};
const portraits = ['ethan', 'maya', 'leo', 'ari'];
function createRoutes(overlay, save, host) {
    function choosePrototype() {
        // Side-scrolling is the approved single gameplay direction.
        overlay.close();
        host.launch('side');
    }
    function daily() {
        const goal = dailyFor(), replay = new ReplayChallengeStore().snapshot, complete = replay.dailyCleared.includes(goal.date);
        const body = overlay.open('Today’s Ally Adventure', `<p>Every day, there’s a new reason to explore Welcome Street. No streaks and no penalties.</p><div class="tiles"><div class="tile"><span class="emoji">★</span><strong>${goal.title}</strong><span>${goal.description}</span><span class="preview-label">${complete ? 'Completed today!' : 'Available today'}</span><button type="button" class="primary" id="aq-daily-play">${complete ? 'Play again' : 'Take the challenge'}</button></div></div>`);
        body.querySelector('#aq-daily-play')?.addEventListener('click', () => { overlay.close(); host.launch('side'); });
    }
    function worldMap() {
        const body = overlay.open('Explore the worlds', `<p>Explore Welcome Street, our side-scrolling development preview. The other four worlds are still being designed.</p><div class="tiles">${worlds.map((world, i) => `<div class="tile" aria-label="${world.title}${i === 0 ? ', playable preview' : ', coming soon'}"><span class="emoji">${world.icon}</span><strong>${world.title}</strong><span>${world.description}</span><span class="preview-label">${i === 0 ? 'Playable adventure' : 'Coming soon'}</span>${i === 0 ? '<button id="aq-world1-launch" type="button" class="primary">Play adventure</button>' : ''}</div>`).join('')}</div>`);
        body.querySelector('#aq-world1-launch')?.addEventListener('click', () => { overlay.close(); host.launch('side'); });
    }
    function crew() {
        const names = ['Ethan', 'Maya', 'Leo', 'Ari'];
        const descriptions = ['Loves inventing new things.', 'Finds clever ways around problems.', 'Always ready to explore.', 'Makes sure everyone belongs.'];
        overlay.open('Meet the Ally Crew', `<p>Four friends, different strengths, one adventure.</p><div class="crew">${portraits.map((name, i) => `<div class="person"><div class="avatar"><img src="${CHARACTER_ART[name]}" alt="${names[i]}" loading="lazy"></div><strong>${names[i]}</strong><p>${descriptions[i]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div>`);
    }
    function workshop() {
        let current = save.snapshot.chairColor;
        const body = overlay.open('My Workshop', `<p>This is a small decorating preview, not a playable adventure level. Your chair color is saved on this device.</p><div style="height:218px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(#f6e8d1,#eacfa5);border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden"><div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;width:100%;height:55px;background:#c79e75"></div><svg width="170" height="180" viewBox="0 0 170 180" style="position:relative"><rect x="38" y="46" width="95" height="80" rx="20" fill="${current}" id="chair-back" stroke="#94633b" stroke-width="5"/><rect x="29" y="109" width="112" height="42" rx="15" fill="${current}" id="chair-seat" stroke="#94633b" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M45 147V166M125 147V166" stroke="#875e3f" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M48 55Q86 39 121 55" stroke="#fff8d5" stroke-width="9" opacity=".65" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><p>Choose a chair color:</p><div class="option-list">${SWATCHES.map(color => `<button class="swatch" type="button" style="background:${color}" data-color="${color}" aria-label="Choose ${color} chair color"></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="coming-note">More customization will arrive after the core game is fun to play.</p>`);
        body.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => { current = btn.dataset.color ?? current; save.update({ chairColor: current }); body.querySelectorAll('#chair-back,#chair-seat').forEach(node => node.setAttribute('fill', current)); overlay.alert('Workshop color saved'); }));
    }
    function settings() {
        const prefs = new PreferencesStore();
        const current = prefs.snapshot;
        const body = overlay.open('Settings', `<p>Make Ally Quest comfortable. All settings are stored only on this device.</p>
      <label class="setting">Gentle trees on home screen <input type="checkbox" id="setting-motion" ${save.snapshot.motionEnabled ? 'checked' : ''}></label>
      <label class="setting">Game sound effects <input type="checkbox" data-game-pref="soundEffects" ${current.soundEffects ? 'checked' : ''}></label>
      <label class="setting">Original game music <input type="checkbox" data-game-pref="music" ${current.music ? 'checked' : ''}></label>
      <label class="setting">Reduce gameplay motion <input type="checkbox" data-game-pref="reducedMotion" ${current.reducedMotion ? 'checked' : ''}></label>
      <label class="setting">Larger touch controls <input type="checkbox" data-game-pref="largerControls" ${current.largerControls ? 'checked' : ''}></label>
      <p class="mini-tip">For more options, open the gear while playing. No accounts, advertising, trackers, or personal information are required.</p>`);
        body.querySelector('#setting-motion')?.addEventListener('change', e => { const v = e.currentTarget.checked; save.update({ motionEnabled: v }); document.body.classList.toggle('motion-off', !v); });
        body.querySelectorAll('[data-game-pref]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('change', () => prefs.update({ [el.dataset.gamePref]: el.checked })));
    }
    const handlers = { play: choosePrototype, map: worldMap, crew, workshop, daily, settings };
    return (route) => handlers[route]();
}

/* module: main */
const app = document.querySelector('#app');
if (!app)
    throw new Error('Application root missing');
const scene = mountHome(app);
attachHomeResponsive(scene);
const save = new SaveStore();
const overlay = new Overlay();
const host = new GameHost(() => { document.querySelector('#home-art')?.focus?.(); }, (stars) => { save.finishLevel('w01-l01', stars); const total = document.getElementById('star-total'); if (total)
    total.textContent = String(save.snapshot.totalStars); });
const navigate = createRoutes(overlay, save, host);
// Screenshot QA only: match frozen approved image, without injecting fake saved progress.
const visualRegression = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('visualBaseline') === 'approved';
const star = document.getElementById('star-total');
if (star)
    star.textContent = String(visualRegression ? 47 : save.snapshot.totalStars);
document.body.classList.toggle('motion-off', !save.snapshot.motionEnabled);
document.querySelectorAll('.action').forEach(node => {
    const route = (node.dataset.open ?? (node.id === 'nav-settings' ? 'settings' : null));
    if (!route)
        return;
    node.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(route));
    node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
        event.preventDefault();
        navigate(route);
    } });
});
</script></body></html>
